name: Target of Opportunity [Combat, Selfish, Teamwork]
body:
You and your allies pelt your enemies with a deadly barrage of missiles.

Prerequisite(s): Point-Blank Shot, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit(s): When an ally makes a ranged attack and hits an opponent within 30 feet of you, you can spend an immediate action to make a single ranged attack against that opponent. Your ranged weapon must be in hand, loaded, and ready to be fired or thrown for you to make the ranged attack.
